paragraphs.text: Capture a note from the DSH composer, keep it out of the way, and manage the list on one page.
# dsh-quicknote
Capture a note from the composer, keep it out of the way, and find it again on one page.
- **From the composer**: click **Quick Note** in the composer toolbar. The card opens with the curre

nt draft; save it
as a note, save and explicitly clear the draft, or jump to the notes page with **V

iew all**.
- **From the sidebar**: search, filter All/Open/Done or by `#tag`, copy, insert into the

active draft, and mark done or
delete with an undo toast.
- **From an agent**: `quicknote_add`, `qui

cknote_list`, `quicknote_done`, `quicknote_delete`.
- **Storage**: `~/.dsh/quicknote/notes.json` — l
ocal, mode `0600`, atomic writes. No telemetry.

<https://dsh-kit.github.io/dsh-quicknote/>

## Data and API

- `GET /api/quicknote/notes`
- `POST /api/quicknote/notes/create` `{ text }`
- `POST /api/quicknote/

notes/update` `{ id, done }`
- `POST /api/quicknote/notes/delete` `{ id }` (returns the removed note

)
